name: Nameless Maw Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Nameless Maw is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with a gaunt wyvern form and burial-cloth wings. It seeks to consume identities, records, and recognition. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Maw and Talons
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Hushed Presence
abilities.description: The dragon cannot be located by sound alone; writing exposed to its breath fades until restored by a GM-approved means.

abilities.name: Breath of Erasure
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 19. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the target cannot speak until its next action. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Unremembered
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose one creature within Close range. It must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable, and allies cannot use actions that target it beneficially until its next action.

abilities.name: Vanishing Record
abilities.description: After the dragon takes damage, mark a Stress to move to a visible place within Close range and become Hidden until it attacks or an enemy finds it with a successful Instinct Roll.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
